description: Unified canonical capability registry for Primary Mathematics Grades 4 and 5.

capabilities.title: Multi-digit Place Value Decomposition & Regrouping
capabilities.description: Decompose multi-digit numbers into standard base-10 positional values and regroup across places.

capabilities.title: Multi-digit Multiplication with Area Model & Partial Products
capabilities.description: Multiply multi-digit whole numbers bridging equal groups, arrays, area models, and vertical partial products.

capabilities.title: Multi-digit Division with Internal Quotient Zero & Remainder Semantics
capabilities.description: Divide multi-digit numbers preserving positional quotient zeros and contextual remainder meanings.

capabilities.title: Fraction Equivalence & Visual Partitioning
capabilities.description: Recognize and generate equivalent fractions using visual strips, area models, and number lines.

capabilities.title: Fraction Comparison with Grounded Reasoning
capabilities.description: Compare fractions with different numerators and denominators using benchmarks or common partitions.

capabilities.title: Fraction Addition and Subtraction
capabilities.description: Add and subtract fractions with like and related denominators using visual repartitioning.

capabilities.title: Decimal Tenths and Hundredths Representation
capabilities.description: Connect decimals to fractions, 10x10 grids, and calibrated number lines.

capabilities.title: Unit Conversions and Multi-step Quantity Chains
capabilities.description: Convert between standard metric/customary units and solve multi-step rate and quantity problems.

capabilities.title: Perimeter vs Area Non-conflation
capabilities.description: Distinguish boundary measure (linear units) from surface covering (square units) on rectilinear figures.

capabilities.title: Volume by Cubic Unit Layers
capabilities.description: Measure volume of rectangular prisms by packing and counting unit cubes across layers.

capabilities.title: Angle Measurement and Geometric Classification
capabilities.description: Classify angles as acute, right, obtuse, or straight and verify geometric orientation.

capabilities.title: Data Interpretation with Calibrated Scales
capabilities.description: Read and create bar graphs and pictograms reconciling key scales with represented data.

capabilities.title: Authentic Notebook Work Alignment and Provenance
capabilities.description: Preserve authentic student work, column alignment, teacher annotations, and error contrast.
